channel.name: legs
channel.purpose: Leg and ankle: design, drop test, gait gantry

context: Channel for Leg (left, hip to foot).
Ongoing: What to show investors when no full humanoid exists. This week: Pressure on legs and controls; exec check-ins twice a week.
Ongoing: Harness conductors breaking at the knee after ~15k flex cycles. This week: Carlos finds two broken phase conductors at the knee after the overnight gait run.
Ongoing: Gait controller tuning for the investor demo on the gait gantry. This week: Foot contact detection flaky; Ravi suggests learned contact estimator, Mei wants foot switches first.
Ongoing: Too many life tests for one grip fixture and one dyno. This week: Lin: grip-cycle test ties up the fixture for 6 days; pinch tests wait.
Ongoing: Whether to machine pelvis plates from 7075 or wait for a casting. This week: Ingrid approves machined plates for DVT only; casting decision deferred to PVT.
